title: Water-supply potential of major streams and the upper Floridan aquifer in the vicinity of Savannah, Georgia
citation: Garza, Reggina, and Krause, R.E., 1997, Water-supply potential of major streams and the upper Floridan aquifer in the vicinity of Savannah, Georgia: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Supply Paper 2411, map scale 1:500,000.
notes:
Hydrologic report (USGS WSP 2411, Savannah GA / Hilton Head SC area); the whole PDF is this one report. No stratigraphic (formation) units are described, so hydrogeologic units are recorded under groundwater only. Thickness and depth statements are put in separate description entries because the groundwater schema has no thickness field. Table 8 water levels are given by model cell (row, column), not by well, and surface-water station flow and water-quality tables (tables 1-6) are not geologic; none of these were recorded. Figure 4 correlation chart text is too scrambled to pair ages with units.
Pages 35-47 are model budgets, sensitivity, development-potential and alternatives text plus the reference list; pages 48-66 are the 19 plates (map text only, scrambled). Tables 9-14 are model results by model cell, not geologic data; not recorded. References: only those bearing on South Carolina or the regional Floridan aquifer system were recorded; Georgia-only, general method and regulation references were skipped. For Smith (1993) the author is shown by a dash in the list and is taken from the preceding entry (flagged inferred).
